alt.en: The "Tickets for this plan" card under the departure day: a 3-day ticket for Universal and a 4-day ticket for Disney side by side, each with its park days, a bar for its validity and buttons to buy it, "Park Hopper is worth it" on the Disney one, and below them the alternative of 14-day tickets from UK shops.

caption.en: Planned without tickets of your own. "Use these as your tickets" makes the suggestions yours, and the days stay where they are. If you already have some, add them at the very bottom.
